Air Cooler Repair & Services near me

Introduction:

When the scorching heat of Vadodara hits its peak, your air cooler becomes your best friend, ensuring relief from the sweltering temperatures. However, what happens when this lifeline malfunctions? In times of emergency, you need prompt and reliable repair services to restore the comfort of your home or workplace. This is where Atlas Aircon steps in, offering comprehensive emergency air cooler repair and services near me in Vadodara. Let’s delve into the importance of timely repairs and the unparalleled assistance provided by Atlas Aircon.

Understanding the Urgency:

As temperatures soar, the functionality of your air cooler becomes critical for maintaining a comfortable environment. A malfunctioning cooler not only disrupts your daily routine but also leads to discomfort and productivity loss. Moreover, in commercial settings, such as offices or shops, a malfunctioning cooler can drive away customers and affect business operations. Recognizing the urgency of the situation, Atlas Aircon prioritizes emergency repair services to swiftly address any issues and restore normalcy.

With years of experience in the HVAC industry, Atlas Aircon boasts a team of skilled technicians proficient in handling all types of air cooler repairs. Whether it’s a minor glitch or a major breakdown, our experts possess the knowledge and expertise to diagnose and resolve the issue efficiently. Equipped with advanced tools and techniques, we ensure that your air cooler is up and running in no time.

Comprehensive Services:

  2. Repair and Replacement: From faulty motors and pumps to damaged cooling pads, we undertake all necessary repairs and replacements using high-quality parts and components.
  3. Cleaning and Maintenance: Regular maintenance is essential for the optimal performance of your air cooler. We offer comprehensive cleaning services to remove dust, debris, and mineral deposits, ensuring efficient cooling.
  4. Upgrades and Installations: Looking to upgrade to a more energy-efficient model? Our experts can guide you through the selection process and handle the installation seamlessly.

Prompt Response:

We understand that air cooler emergencies can occur at any time, day or night. That’s why Atlas Aircon operates round-the-clock to provide timely assistance when you need it the most. Simply give us a call, and our team will be at your doorstep, ready to resolve the issue swiftly and effectively.

Customer Satisfaction Guaranteed:

At Atlas Aircon, customer satisfaction is our top priority. We strive to deliver service excellence in every interaction, ensuring that your air cooler operates at peak efficiency. Our transparent pricing, prompt response, and commitment to quality have earned us the trust of countless satisfied customers across Vadodara.

  7. Limited Warranty Coverage: While Atlas Aircon uses quality parts and components, warranty coverage may vary, and customers should inquire about warranty terms to understand their rights and potential liabilities.

Price List of “Air Cooler Repair & Services”

  1. Basic Inspection and Cleaning:
    • Price Range: ₹500 to ₹1,500
    • Description: Includes inspection of the air cooler, cleaning of filters, and basic components. Additional charges may apply for replacement of damaged parts.
  2. Motor Replacement:
    • Price Range: ₹1,000 to ₹2,500
    • Description: Replacement of the air cooler motor, including labor and the cost of the new motor. Prices may vary based on the motor’s capacity and brand.
  3. Pump Replacement:
    • Price Range: ₹800 to ₹1,800
    • Description: Replacement of the water pump in the air cooler, including labor charges. The price may vary depending on the pump’s capacity and brand.
  4. Pad Replacement:
    • Price Range: ₹300 to ₹800 (per pad)
    • Description: Replacement of cooling pads in the air cooler. The cost may vary based on the type and size of cooling pads required.
  5. Fan Repair/Replacement:
    • Price Range: ₹700 to ₹1,500
    • Description: Repair or replacement of the fan in the air cooler, including labor charges. Prices may vary based on the fan’s size and type.
  6. Electrical Wiring and Switch Repair:
    • Price Range: ₹400 to ₹1,000
    • Description: Repair or replacement of faulty electrical wiring, switches, or controls in the air cooler. Prices may vary based on the extent of the electrical work needed.
  7. Complete Overhaul Service:
    • Price Range: ₹2,000 to ₹5,000
    • Description: Comprehensive servicing of the air cooler, including cleaning, motor and pump checks, pad replacement, and any necessary repairs. Prices vary based on the air cooler’s size and condition.
  8. Installation of New Air Cooler:
    • Price Range: ₹2,500 to ₹8,000
    • Description: Installation of a new air cooler, including setting up the unit, connecting water supply, and ensuring proper functionality. Prices vary based on the air cooler’s capacity and features.
  9. Gas Charging (if applicable):
    • Price Range: ₹1,500 to ₹3,500
    • Description: Charging or recharging refrigerant gas in air coolers equipped with a refrigeration system. Prices may vary based on the type and amount of refrigerant required.
  10. Emergency or Same-Day Service:
    • Price Range: Additional ₹500 to ₹1,000
    • Description: Additional charge for urgent or same-day air cooler repair services. Prices vary based on service provider policies.
  11. Extra Parts Charges:
    • Air Cooler On/Off Knobs and Switchs: ₹50
    • Air Cooler Remote: ₹500
    • Air Cooler Swing Motor: ₹950
    • Air Cooler Blower: ₹1800
    • Air Cooler Fan Blade: ₹950
    • Air Cooler Fan Motor: ₹1500/₹3500
    • Air Cooler Filters: ₹1000
    • Air Cooler Honeycomb Pad: ₹1500
    • Air Cooler Water Pump: ₹800 / ₹1500
    • Air Cooler Stand: ₹500
Description: Additional charge for urgent or same-day air cooler repair services. Prices vary based on service provider policies.
Note: These prices are indicative and subject to change. It is advisable to obtain detailed quotes from local service providers based on the specific make and model of your air cooler and the nature of the repair or service required.
